name: Talk of the Town
summary: A friendly barkeep points travelers eager for a livelier gathering toward the port of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale. Those looking for wilder company are directed to seek out Nixxrax Fillamug at the Salty Sailor Tavern.

sections.title: A Word Across the Counter
sections.body: Word passes quickly between drink-servers and their patrons, and news travels far beyond the local counter. A friendly bartender passes along a tip about where the genuine commotion is brewing, pointing anyone searching for wilder spectacles toward the port of Booty Bay.

sections.title: The Salty Sailor
sections.body: The destination is the Salty Sailor Tavern, a lively establishment maintained by goblins amidst the bustle of Stranglethorn Vale. There, Nixxrax Fillamug keeps cups topped up for anyone who walks in.

faq.answer: This leads to Stranglethorn Vale, straight to the goblin-run port town of Booty Bay.

faq.q: Who are you supposed to find in Booty Bay?
faq.answer: You are directed to find Nixxrax Fillamug inside the Salty Sailor Tavern, where he keeps everyone's drinks topped up.

faq.q: Why send someone all the way to Stranglethorn Vale?
faq.answer: Bartenders hear all the gossip from their patrons, and word has it that the Salty Sailor Tavern holds the wildest festivities around, regardless of goblin management.

attribution: In-game quest text: Talk of the Town
